title: Register Update of a Represented Configuration
statement: For any states $s,s'$, input-head position $ip$, natural numbers $v,v'$, and integer positions $q,q'$, updating the work tape and head position of the represented configuration with state $s'$, input-head position $ip$, stored value $v'$, and work-tape head at $q'$ yields the represented configuration with state $s$, input-head position $ip$, stored value $v'$, and work-tape head at $q$.
